title: The Law School Desk and Bag Setup, All Pink
intro: A pink desk is not a joke. It is a desk mat that hides the scratches on a rental desk, an acrylic organizer so the pens stop rolling, a stationery set that makes the case brief bearable and a riser that gets the screen up where your neck wants it. The bag that carries the laptop home is pink too, because the tote and the sleeve are the two pieces people see. This one is evergreen: it sells in August and again in January.

images.alt: Collage on cream of a pink leather desk mat, a pink acrylic organizer, a pink stapler set, pink sticky notes, a wooden monitor riser, a cream laptop sleeve with a bow and a pink puffer tote.
Woman in an oversized pink sweatshirt working at a wooden desk in a pink attic loft, laptop on a wooden riser over a pink leather desk mat, a pink puffer tote on the chair, holding a pink tumbler.
